editProfile.shownOnYourKycDocument: Shown on your KYC document. Only your first name is shown to customers during a delivery.

interstate.howMuchWeightCanYou: How much weight can you take above your existing load.
interstate.eGTheFillingStation: e.g. the filling station before the toll gate
interstate.tapASuggestionSoThis: Tap a suggestion so this stop gets a real pin. Typed on its own it is only words, and words cannot settle where you actually waited.
interstate.offTheAddressAndWe: off the address, and we are not certain of it. Check it before you declare: passengers find this trip by searching that name.
interstate.longestTripYouWillTake: Longest trip you will take (km). Leave empty for no limit.
interstate.setOutTheWholeRun: Set out the whole run before you leave: where you start, anywhere you stop, where you finish. Passengers can book your spare seats, and packages going the same way are ranked towards you.
interstate.nameEveryPlaceYouWill: Name every place you will stop, in order, before you set off. Passengers book days ahead and plan around the route you sell them.
interstate.addAStopOnThe: Add a stop on the way
interstate.stopsIsTheLimitOn: stops is the limit on one run. You have to stop at every one of these, and a route nobody can hold you to is worth nothing.
interstate.measuredAlongTheStopsYou: Measured along the stops you picked, not between city centres. SEIRS sets this, not the driver, because it is what passengers are charged per kilometre.
interstate.estimateTheExactFigureIs: Estimate. The exact figure is priced when a passenger books, and a night or weekend departure pays more.
interstate.noDeparturesLeftOnThis: No departures left on this day. Pick tomorrow, or a later date, above.
interstate.showsYourSpareKgTo: Shows your spare kg to senders on this route
interstate.packagesRunningYourDeclaredRoute: Packages running your declared route are ranked towards you around your departure. Nothing is forced on you: skip any package that does not suit the run. A seat request is different: it is made to you alone and nothing is charged until you accept it. Say yes or no, and it expires if you leave it unanswered.

lastOrder.whatHappensWhenYouWind: What happens when you wind down
lastOrder.noNewJobsWillBe: No new jobs will be assigned to you. You will still complete the ones you have already accepted.
lastOrder.cannotBeTurnedOffUntil: Cannot be turned off until you fully sign off
lastOrder.tellTheDispatcherYouRe: Tell the dispatcher you're done after your current jobs. Cleanly stop accepting new orders without going offline mid-trip.
lastOrder.lastOrderRequires80This: Last Order requires ≥80%. This stops drivers from gaming the toggle to skip undesirable orders.

multiLeg.whenYouAcceptAJob: When you accept a job, it appears here. Multiple legs along the same corridor get bundled into a pool trip.
multiLeg.theDispatcherSilentlyInsertsLegs: The dispatcher silently inserts legs that lie within 1km of your route + add ≤20% to your time. You don't need to accept each insertion: just complete legs in the order shown.

notifications.talkToAPersonAbout: Talk to a person about it
notifications.alertOpsAndShareMy: Alert ops and share my live location now

parcelRequests.seatAndParcelRequestsShow: Seat and parcel requests show up here. Nothing is charged until you accept, so you can say no without costing anybody money.
parcelRequests.waitingForTheSenderTo: . Waiting for the sender to answer.
parcelRequests.nameAPlaceOnYour: Name a place on your route you can actually reach. The sender sees it with a fresh price and can accept or say no. Nothing is charged either way.

sos.eGPassengerIsThreatening: e.g. Passenger is threatening me, I am parked at the filling station
sos.thisAlertsSeirsOpsAnd: This alerts SEIRS ops and shares your live location with them. Nobody else is told.
sos.oneTapSharesYourLive: One tap shares your live location with SEIRS ops. Use this for real emergencies only.
sos.couldNotLoadTheFull: Could not load the full directory. These national numbers still work.
sos.supportIsAlreadyAlertedAnd: Support is already alerted and your location is being shared. This is optional: it just tells them what they are coming into.

statement.nothingSettledInThisPeriod: Nothing settled in this period. Try a wider one.
statement.everyFigureCoversThePeriod: Every figure covers the period shown above it, never your whole history with SEIRS. Earnings still clearing are not counted here. The exported copy carries a code anyone can check, so it works as proof of income.

statusBroadcast.gpsMayBeDelayedBut: GPS may be delayed but I'm on the way
statusBroadcast.heldUpOnTheRoad: Held up on the road, still on my way
statusBroadcast.triggerAnAlertToOps: Trigger an alert to ops with my last known location
statusBroadcast.tapAnyStatusToSend: Tap any status to send it to the customer. Sending needs a connection: if it fails, nothing is stored, so try again once you have signal.
statusBroadcast.yourCustomerSeesTheLast: Your customer sees the last position SEIRS received from you. If you lose signal, that position stops updating until you are back online.

storeHandoff.optionalTheParcelOnThe: Optional. The parcel on the counter, or the counter book with the entry in it.
storeHandoff.theirFullNameFirstAnd: Their full name, first and last.
storeHandoff.byTypingTheirNameThey: By typing their name they confirm they
storeHandoff.thisParcelNigerianEvidenceAct: this parcel. Nigerian Evidence Act, section 84.
storeHandoff.ifTheCounterCanShow: If the counter can show their SEIRS ID, add it. It ties the name to a registered store.
storeHandoff.optionalSkipItIfThe: Optional. Skip it if the queue is moving.

trunkCheck.frameTheInsideOfThe: Frame the inside of the trunk so all remaining packages are visible.
trunkCheck.ifAnythingIsMissingDo: If anything is missing, do NOT continue. Pull over safely and contact support before driving further, and keep the photo on your phone.

vehicle.eGSoldTheKeke: e.g. Sold the keke and bought a Boxer
vehicle.registrationPapersEvenIfThey: Registration papers, even if they are in the owner's name
vehicle.mustBeValidAndCover: Must be valid and cover this vehicle
vehicle.howDoYouWantTo: How do you want to add it?
vehicle.aFileFromYourEmail: A file from your email or your insurer
vehicle.doYouStillHaveYour: Do you still have your current vehicle?
vehicle.itChangesWhatWeDo: It changes what we do while your new one is being reviewed, so it is worth getting right.
vehicle.yesICanStillRide: Yes, I can still ride it
vehicle.itStopsTheReviewNothing: It stops the review. Nothing about your current vehicle changes, and you can submit again whenever you are ready.
vehicle.ourTeamHasYourSubmission: Our team has your submission. You keep working with your current vehicle until it is approved, and you will hear back through your support messages.
vehicle.sameProofYouGaveFor: Same proof you gave for the vehicle at sign-up, nothing about you personally. Your ID, licence and selfie stay as they are.
vehicle.thisChangesWhatJobsYou: This changes what jobs you are offered and what they pay, which is why an admin has to approve it.
vehicle.freshPhotosOfTheVehicle: Fresh photos of the vehicle you are registering now, not the old one.

identitydocuments.aFileFromYourEmail: A file from your email or a portal
identitydocuments.tapItAndUploadThe: . Tap it and upload the current one.
identitydocuments.askedOnceTheseDoNot: Asked once. These do not change when you change vehicle, so you will not be asked for them again.

insurancepartners.seirsEarnsAReferralFee: SEIRS earns a referral fee when you buy through a partner. It does not change what you pay.

packagecodecapture.youCanStillFinishThis: You can still finish this hand-off: type the code below.

vehicleownershipform.iAmStillPayingFor: I am still paying for it
vehicleownershipform.ownerGivesItOutI: Owner gives it out, I pay daily
vehicleownershipform.plentyOfRidersWorkA: Plenty of riders work a vehicle that is not theirs. That is fine, and it is not a problem for your application. We only need the owner to confirm they are happy for you to use it.
vehicleownershipform.theOwnershipDocumentYouUpload: The ownership document you upload should be in your own name.
vehicleownershipform.ourTeamCallsThisNumber: Our team calls this number to confirm the owner agreed.
vehicleownershipform.howDoYouComeTo: How do you come to be riding it?
vehicleownershipform.aShortLetterIsEnough: A short letter is enough. It should say the owner's name, the vehicle and plate number, your name, that you have permission to use it for SEIRS work, and the date. The owner signs it by hand. Photograph the whole page.
vehicleownershipform.handYourPhoneToThe: Hand your phone to the owner. Typing their full name here is a legal signature in Nigeria, exactly like signing the paper. It has to match the name above.
vehicleownershipform.byTypingTheirNameThe: By typing their name the owner confirms they own this vehicle and agree to you using it for SEIRS work. Nigerian Evidence Act, section 84.
